title: Statistical Mechanics
description: Temperature, pressure and entropy are averages over states too many to count: each weighted by e^(−E/kT). Sum the weights and the partition function holds every property of the system.

puzzle.goal: Two states differ in energy by E. At temperature T, write the ratio r of how often the upper one is found to how often the lower one is, with Boltzmann's k.
puzzle.name: Population ratio
puzzle.ask: Find r for E = @{E} J (0.1 eV), k = 1.381e-23 J/K, T = @{T} K.
puzzle.method: Each state is weighted by e^(−E/kT); the ratio of two weights depends only on their difference.
